Built a playable hunting simulation in `index.html` and `game.js`. It includes a custom-rendered wilderness, a deer herd that reacts to noise and wind, movement and concealment, scoped aiming, rifle recoil and wind drift, tracking, and a field-examination harvest screen. Desktop and touch controls are supported.

**Controls:** WASD to move, Shift to walk faster, Ctrl to crouch, right-click to scope, left-click to fire, E to interact, and R to reload. On mobile, use the on-screen controls.

I assumed a desktop-first, top-down 2D presentation with responsive touch support. Verified the game loads without console errors, checked the firing feedback in-browser, and ran `node --check game.js`. The latest visual check is `screenshots/wildlands.jpg` (1280×800).
